scenario.name: Dragos FrostyGoop Report, CERT-UA & CISA ICS — Industrial ENCO Controller Modbus TCP Port 502 Register Audit
scenario.overview: Imagine a city district-heating boiler house whose basement thermostat panel was accidentally wired to an unlocked public intercom outside on the street. In the dead of winter, an outside caller rings the intercom to ask which boiler model is running, reads every water-temperature gauge across the apartment blocks, and then dials false temperature calibration numbers directly into the panel so the heaters shut down during freezing weather. In this scenario (T1190, Dragos FrostyGoop Report, CERT-UA & CISA ICS, Industrial ENCO Controller Modbus TCP Port 502 Register Audit), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: external Modbus TCP Port 502 Session, then bulk Holding Register Enumeration, then holding Register Overwrite via Function. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering External Modbus TCP Port 502 Session, then Bulk Holding Register Enumeration, then Holding Register Overwrite via Function, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on Zeek Event 502 correlated across the documented kill chain.
